claim_verbatim: The market faces a projected supply deficit of >500,000 tonnes in 2025.
probability_words: projected supply deficit of >500,000 tonnes in 2025
resolution_criterion: YES if ICSG final 2025 refined copper balance shows deficit >500 kt; NO if surplus or deficit <=500 kt.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if ICSG final 2025 refined copper balance shows deficit >500 kt; NO if surplus or deficit <=500 kt.
notes: RESOLVED 2026-10-14. Claim was ICSG final 2025 refined balance deficit >500 kt. ICSG February 2026 Copper Bulletin (preliminary full-year December data) reported a preliminary refined copper SURPLUS of about 380,000 tonnes for 2025 (ScrapMonster 25 Feb 2026 summary of ICSG bulletin). ICSG 23 Apr 2026 Press Release supply-demand table lists World Refined Balance for 2025 as +455 kt (surplus). No ICSG source found showing a 2025 deficit >500 kt; all point to surplus. Criterion: NO if surplus or deficit <=500 kt → resolved_false. Mechanism for the miss unclear vs essay framing. Appended superseding line; prior open line kept.

claim_verbatim: There is zero chance of ever building these machines in time to make a difference.
context: DAC machines required by decarbonisation models for net-zero-by-2050 pathways; essay costs them at ~$27 trillion and ~500,000 km² land.
source: X article 'Net-Zero by 2050 Came From Computer Models. So Did the Fictional Fantasy Machines That Make It Work.' (status 2109528525762109557)
probability_words: zero chance (of building in time) → will not be built in time
resolution_criterion: TRUE if global operational Direct Air Capture capacity is below 1 GtCO2/year at end-2050 (machines not built at the multi-Gt scale the pathways use as backstop). FALSE if operational DAC capacity is >= 1 GtCO2/year by 2050-12-31. Source: Global CCS Institute / IEA / peer-reviewed DAC capacity tallies.
resolution_rule_fixed: TRUE if global operational Direct Air Capture capacity is below 1 GtCO2/year at end-2050 (machines not built at the multi-Gt scale the pathways use as backstop). FALSE if operational DAC capacity is >= 1 GtCO2/year by 2050-12-31. Source: Global CCS Institute / IEA / peer-reviewed DAC capacity tallies.
resolution_source_planned: Global CCS Institute status reports; IEA; peer-reviewed DAC capacity inventories
mechanism: Decarbonisation models price a DAC backstop without materials, land, energy or hydroxide mass balances; physical build cannot reach pathway scale by 2050.
notes: Inferred 0.90 from 'zero chance' of building (= certain they will not be built in time). Queued for Craig to confirm. Extracted 2026-10-14 after prior-run read failure on this X article.

claim_verbatim: The IEA net-zero scenario needs air capture of "more than 85 Mt of CO2 in 2030" and "around 980 MtCO2 in 2050"; 85 million tonnes is 170 plants the size of Stratos by 2030, and 980 million tonnes is 1,960 of them by 2050. ... The IEA path needs 170 Stratos plants running by 2030. Stratos, the first, is two years late.
context: Paired with 'zero chance of ever building these machines in time'; near-term checkable DAC build rate vs IEA NZ.
source: X article 'Net-Zero by 2050 Came From Computer Models. So Did the Fictional Fantasy Machines That Make It Work.' (status 2109528525762109557)
probability_words: zero chance / Stratos two years late → will not meet 170 Stratos-scale plants by 2030
resolution_criterion: TRUE if global operational DAC capacity is below 85 MtCO2/year at end-2030 (IEA NZ 2030 air-capture figure he cites, ≈170×0.5 Mt Stratos-scale plants). FALSE if operational DAC capacity is >= 85 MtCO2/year by 2030-12-31.
resolution_rule_fixed: TRUE if global operational DAC capacity is below 85 MtCO2/year at end-2030 (IEA NZ 2030 air-capture figure he cites, ≈170×0.5 Mt Stratos-scale plants). FALSE if operational DAC capacity is >= 85 MtCO2/year by 2030-12-31.
resolution_source_planned: Global CCS Institute / IEA DAC capacity tallies for 2030
mechanism: First commercial-scale DAC plant (Stratos) already late; pathway build rate is physically implausible.
notes: Inferred 0.90 from zero-chance framing plus the late-Stratos evidence he cites. Scorable near-term companion to pl-080. Queued for Craig to confirm.

claim_verbatim: On the IPCC's own figures, the route to net zero by 2050 is implausible. The 2050 route fails as a plan. ... I reject it. I call the policy built on the 2050 date folly.
context: Closing judgment of the net-zero X article; earlier line: 'net zero by 2050 is implausible, and the policy built on it is folly.'
source: X article 'Net-Zero by 2050 Came From Computer Models. So Did the Fictional Fantasy Machines That Make It Work.' (status 2109528525762109557)
probability_words: implausible / fails as a plan / folly → will not achieve global net zero by 2050
resolution_criterion: TRUE if global anthropogenic CO2 emissions are not at net zero in calendar year 2050 (Energy Institute Statistical Review / IEA / UNFCCC inventory basis: gross fossil+industrial CO2 not matched by durable removals to net zero). FALSE if they are at net zero in 2050.
resolution_rule_fixed: TRUE if global anthropogenic CO2 emissions are not at net zero in calendar year 2050 (Energy Institute Statistical Review / IEA / UNFCCC inventory basis: gross fossil+industrial CO2 not matched by durable removals to net zero). FALSE if they are at net zero in 2050.
resolution_source_planned: Energy Institute Statistical Review; IEA; UNFCCC national inventories / IPCC emissions datasets
mechanism: Net-zero-2050 pathways depend on removal machines and materials that do not exist at required scale.
notes: Inferred 0.90 from 'implausible' / 'fails as a plan' / 'folly'. Global CO2 net zero in 2050 is the fixed criterion. Queued for Craig to confirm.

claim_verbatim: The remaining budget for 1.5°C was 170 billion tonnes, about four years of 2025 emissions. By my count, at the 2025 rate the world spends the 170 billion tonnes around 2030, twenty years before the 2050 date.
context: IPCC remaining 1.5°C carbon budget figure as used in the essay; exhaustion timing if 2025 emission rate continues.
source: X article 'Net-Zero by 2050 Came From Computer Models. So Did the Fictional Fantasy Machines That Make It Work.' (status 2109528525762109557)
resolution_criterion: TRUE if the 170 GtCO2 remaining 1.5°C budget he cites (from the essay's source basis at date_made) is exhausted by 2031-12-31 on Global Carbon Project / IPCC budget tracking ('around 2030' read as through end-2031). FALSE if that 170 Gt tranche is still unexhausted at end-2031.
resolution_rule_fixed: TRUE if the 170 GtCO2 remaining 1.5°C budget he cites (from the essay's source basis at date_made) is exhausted by 2031-12-31 on Global Carbon Project / IPCC budget tracking ('around 2030' read as through end-2031). FALSE if that 170 Gt tranche is still unexhausted at end-2031.
resolution_source_planned: Global Carbon Project; IPCC carbon budget updates
mechanism: Arithmetic on stated remaining budget ÷ 2025 annual emissions.
notes: Inferred 0.90 from confident 'by my count'. 'Around 2030' fixed as through 2031-12-31. Budget baseline is the 170 Gt figure as of the essay; do not silently swap a later revised budget without a superseding note. Queued for Craig to confirm.
